works.title: Sea Pictures
works.subtitle: Song cycle, Op. 37
works.scoring: Contralto (or mezzo-soprano) solo, orchestra; also voice and piano

dedicatee.name: Clara Butt
dedicatee.note: Premiered by Clara Butt, Norwich Festival, 5 October 1899 — background context, not yet confirmed against a primary source in our records.

works.summary: Five settings for solo voice on the theme of the sea, composed to texts by five different poets and first performed as a cycle at the 1899 Norwich Festival.

works.title: Sea Slumber Song
works.subtitle: No. 1 from Sea Pictures
works.textIncipit: Sea-birds are asleep, the world forgets to weep

works.title: In Haven
works.subtitle: No. 2 from Sea Pictures — also known as ‘Capri’
works.textIncipit: Closely let me hold thy hand, storms are weeping sea and land
works.earlierVersionNote: Originally composed in 1897 under the title 'Love alone will stay', published in the magazine The Dome (1898); only minor revisions made for inclusion in Sea Pictures.

works.title: Sabbath Morning at Sea
works.subtitle: No. 3 from Sea Pictures
works.textIncipit: The ship went on with solemn face: to meet the darkness on the deep

works.title: Where Corals Lie
works.subtitle: No. 4 from Sea Pictures
works.textIncipit: The deeps have music soft and low
works.dataQualityNote: The live RISM record currently states the opus as 'Op. 37/1' (duplicating Sea Slumber Song). Frankie's cataloguing spreadsheet correctly has 'Op. 37/4'. Flagged for correction at source; this sample uses the correct value.
